lines.1: 「Which one goes? Pick your favorite finger.」
lines.3: 「I told you I would take a finger if you attacked me. Select one you do not mind having broken.」
lines.4: 「Come on! That was just an accident!」
lines.6: 「What are you talking about? What would be like me?」
lines.10: 「Hm...? What is it? Do you need something?」
lines.11: 「Oh, this outfit? There is nothing to be concerned about.」
lines.12: 「I am an athlete, after all. It does not bother me in the slightest. Hah! Hahahaha!」
lines.14: 「...Give me the ring finger of your left hand. That should cause the fewest complications.」
lines.18: 「My name is Iron... 'Maiden,' remember? A teenage girl in the flower of youth.」
lines.19: 「Wait! A young girl wouldn't use a high side kick like th--」
lines.22: 「Should I make up for it by taking my clothes off too?」
lines.23: 「Who wants to see a man strip?! Stop fooling around!」
lines.24: 「Go for a run and cool your head!」
lines.25: 「How far am I supposed to run...?」
